verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a REST API (task, session, event and custom-tool endpoints), so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
